comment: Terminology drift: 'minimum viable foundation' (2.2.1), 'foundational core' / 'essential core' (2.2.1), and 'REDDHI minimum viable layer' (4.2.1, line 78) are used interchangeably without definition of whether they denote the same construct. Given that this construct carries the document's sequencing logic, the drift invites divergent interpretation in procurement and conformance documents.
